# HITL dogfood: Limatus on published Pilobolus

## Intent

As Ryan (publication operator), I want to scan every published Pilobolus article with current Limatus, record my own skip/rewrite/delete/keep/add decisions, review ranked rewrite options, and apply only what I chose — so we dogfood Limatus on live copy without a silent editor or auto-publish.

## Guardrails

- Source of published copy: latest `origin/main` of Pilobol.us (`web/content/articles/*.md`, not `index.md`).
- Style profile: Papyrus `publications/pilobolus/style-profile.yml`.
- Limatus must not invent decisions. Options run only after recorded `rewrite`.
- Working copies change only after an explicit human apply. Site publish stays a separate human gate.
- Do not merge dirty local Pilobol.us; dogfood from an isolated checkout of origin.

## Loop

scan → human decisions → options (rewrite only) → compare shortlist → human choose → apply to working copy → human publish.

## Out of scope

Newsroom UI. Auto-apply compare winners. Detector-score optimization. Unattended whole-document rewrite.
